dense_reference.note: Frozen Task 3.3 winner. Identity/metrics are loaded live from results/phase3_3/qwen3_embedding.json at run time (never hardcoded/recomputed here) and used only for Stage 8's paired dense-vs-sparse comparison and for provenance in the Task 3.4 run record's embedding_model field - the dense model computes no sparse query scores.

fts_index_config.note: Simplest documented/default LanceDB 0.37.1 FTS() configuration - verified empirically against a disposable synthetic table (Stage 2), never assumed from memory or tuned for this project.

score_contract.note: Native LanceDB FTS BM25-style score, preserved faithfully and never renamed to a dense-style 'distance'/'cosine score', never normalized across queries, never combined with a dense score in Task 3.4.

query_transform.note: Raw user question text, verbatim, EXCEPT literal ASCII double-quote characters (U+0022) are stripped before the query reaches LanceDB's FTS parser. Verified empirically (Stage 2/6): with with_position=false (this config's frozen default), any '"'-containing query is parsed as a phrase query and raises ValueError('Invalid input, position is not found but required for phrase queries...') for perfectly ordinary natural-language input - this is the one deterministic, documented sanitization rule Stage 6 permits, applied identically to every query. Verified separately that none of the 89 frozen DEV question texts contain a literal double-quote character, so this rule never changes the formal Task 3.4 result - it exists only so the general-purpose SparseRetriever boundary does not crash on ordinary text. No other query rewriting, expansion, synonym handling, or SEC-specific dictionary is applied.

metric_definitions: doc_recall@10 / doc_recall@50 / doc_mrr / doc_ndcg@10 via src.eval.baseline_metrics (Task 1.10) + src.eval.metrics (Task 2.6) + src.eval.phase3_baseline.document_relevances_at_k (Task 3.1's nDCG double-counting fix) - unmodified, identical semantics to Tasks 3.1-3.3. chunk_recall@10, chunk_mrr, precision_at_5, faithfulness, citation_grounding, and generation metrics remain N/A.
comparison_policy: Analysis only (PROJECT_EXECUTION.md Task 3.4 Stage 8): sparse-only results are paired-compared against the frozen Task 3.3 qwen3_embedding dense winner by question_id, using src.eval.phase3_ablation.paired_bootstrap_delta_ci (reused unmodified) for doc_recall@10/@50, doc_mrr, and doc_ndcg@10 deltas. No automatic winner is selected, no RRF/hybrid fusion is implemented, and no dense+sparse score combination occurs in Task 3.4. Dense-only/sparse-only/both/neither complementarity at hit@10 and hit@50 is reported as evidence for the Task 3.5 hybrid-fusion decision, not as a pass/fail gate on the sparse baseline itself.
